standard_prerequisites.name: Unit interval orders, totally nonnegative matrices, permanent path-family interpretations, Catalan star networks and Bruhat rank-matrix order
standard_prerequisites.statement: All source-local labeling/network/bijection algorithms, parity subsets and parameter restrictions retained literally. Standard tableau/pairing criterion and Bruhat rank criterion remain original cited facts.
standard_prerequisites.use: Complete original constructive combinatorial proofs and all native inline diagrams supplied; no reconstruction of prior matrix-inequality proofs or independent Lean/MATLAB verification.

core_obligations: The author builds an explicit bijection from a balanced Young subgroup to parity-preserving permutations and proves Bruhat monotonicity by rank-matrix comparisons with separate even/odd induction and block-case analysis. The pairing criterion then gives the balanced inequality for arbitrary TNN matrices; this all-TNN balanced target is distinct from the unit-interval-order arbitrary-split target.
